The service times are too long so the jobs pile up and hit `pending_capacity` (512) → "queue" decisions. Let me use service=1 so jobs complete quickly, allowing all packets to be sent.

With service=1, done = t+1 > t, so a job created at time t finishes before the packet at t+1 (if the next packet's time > t). Since gaps are >= 1, done = t+1 <= t+1 = next time ✓ → the job finishes before the next packet. So pending stays small.

Let me redo with service=1.
